_rule: Written and committed BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). Cost = the 300-frame 'rt passes' / 'gi' / 'scene build GPU' lines and '[hair primary] strand G-buffer draws GPU' per cost window; cards = mean(cost-cards, cost-cards-b), |a - b| its noise. Styles = the '[hair groom] frame N: K groom instances' and 'unmatched hair draw' lines (every converted style in data/assetdb/hair_grooms).

coverage.predicted: with every style converted (batch over 1217 LOD0/LOD1 CHAR_Hair objects), most hair draws of the scene match: Dialogue1 >= 5 groom instances (hg-20261103e: 5 with 17 files), camp several companions; the remaining 'unmatched hair draw' lines name styles the batch rejected or did not see

cost-crowd vs cost-strands.predicted: Dialogue1 (few large characters): the budget does not bind, equal within noise. Camp: the plan line shows coarser LODs for the far characters; scene build GPU and the groom VRAM lower, trace cost about equal (it scales with hair pixels, not segments)
cost-crowd vs cost-strands.kept_if: no visible LOD pops on the shot pair at the camp

cost-strands vs cost-cards.predicted: with rt_hair_groom live (strands in RT and on screen) vs native cards: rt passes and gi lower by the hg-20261103e amounts per matched character (rt -1.1..1.5 ms, gi -1.6..1.8 ms in Dialogue1) plus strand G-buffer draws 0.2-0.6 ms per close character; scene build GPU +0.06 ms per character

strike_rule_20261103.hypothesis: hv5 2026-11-03: every groom of a counted frame struck at once (0 strand pixels with the counted tag) because the G-buffer ran against another publish (the build is recorded at the end of the prepass; the game may submit the G-buffer in another order), so the record's tag was an adjacent frame's.

predicted.strand_draws: every 300-frame '[hair primary] frame' line in a strand window after the 300-frame swap pause: G-buffer and velocity strand draws > 0 (hv5 strand stages, hair_crowd cost-strands/cost-crowd)
predicted.strikes: 'drew no pixel' lines: 0 on Dialogue1 with the characters on screen; any strike retires the draw for 600 frames only ('its cards come back for 600 frames') and names its per-groom counted+adjacent pixels
predicted.misaligned: if the hypothesis holds: '[hair primary] counted frame F: its N strand pixels carry an adjacent frame's tag' lines appear (count > 0) where hv5 struck; if they never appear and strikes still occur with 0+0 pixels, the hypothesis is refuted (then: no ray found a strand)

strike_rule_20261103.invalid_if: a strand window without a '[hair primary] frame' line, or the strand key not latched (no '[hair primary] header at' line)
